conversation.message: What makes X-rays a serendipitous discovery?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays by accident while experimenting with cathode rays, noticing a fluorescent screen glowing even when not directly exposed. This unexpected phenomenon led to his further investigation and the eventual understanding and application of X-rays.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
